title: Mouse dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#2a3d66'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M62 78 C74 80, 78 68, 72 62 C68 58, 74 54, 78 58' fill='none' stroke='#f7a8c4' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f08fb0'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f08fb0'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='37' y='74' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#b9c2d6'/>
  <rect x='55' y='74' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#b9c2d6'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='18' ry='17' fill='#b9c2d6'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='11' ry='11' fill='#e8ecf5'/>
  <!-- arms up dancing -->
  <path d='M34 56 C26 48, 24 40, 28 34' fill='none' stroke='#b9c2d6' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 56 C74 48, 76 40, 72 34' fill='none' stroke='#b9c2d6' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='33' r='4' fill='#f08fb0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='33' r='4' fill='#f08fb0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='10' fill='#b9c2d6'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='6' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='10' fill='#b9c2d6'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='6' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#cdd5e6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3' fill='#1b2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='3' fill='#1b2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#f08fb0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 52, 56 47' fill='none' stroke='#1b2a4a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M34 42 L24 40 M34 45 L24 46' stroke='#8a94ad' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 42 L76 40 M66 45 L76 46' stroke='#8a94ad' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <path d='M84 20 L84 32' stroke='#7ee0c0' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='81' cy='33' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#7ee0c0'/>
  <path d='M16 24 L16 36' stroke='#ffd76e' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='13' cy='37' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffd76e'/>
</svg>
